title: The ledger's reading is wrong where it ignores integration: a defect
situation: Every integrated cut reads open or in flight. The ledger records each event as it occurs, the integrated event included; its reading computes a cut's phase from its work packages' last statuses and ignores that event. The operator, 2026-10-13: the record gate, the ledger's misreading and the CI's special checks are grey-field patches; the conceptual model conflated the bounded context of the product's users with the context of developing and releasing the product, which dogfoods the workflow but is a context of its own.
decision: No design is needed: by the ledger and 0149, an integrated cut is integrated. The reading that says otherwise is a defect, repaired in the checks cut (0156).
consequences: Every cut integrated so far reads integrated, with no record added or changed.
